source:
Crea únicamente el mapa de un juego de terror multijugador en Roblox. No agregues personajes, NPC, scripts, interfaces, armas, mecánicas ni sistemas de juego. Solo crea el escenario.
El mapa debe ser un bosque enorme y denso durante la noche, completamente en 3D, con una atmósfera oscura, misteriosa y realista. Debe tener árboles gigantes, vegetación abundante, senderos estrechos, rocas, troncos caídos, colinas, ríos, lagos pequeños y niebla ligera.
El mapa debe ser extremadamente grande, aproximadamente 2000x2000 studs, con sensación de mundo abierto. Los jugadores deben poder explorar durante varios minutos sin llegar rápidamente al límite del mapa. Divide el bosque en diferentes zonas con ambientes distintos.
Incluye puntos de interés como una cabaña abandonada, una torre de vigilancia, un campamento destruido, un puente de madera, una entrada a una cueva y vehículos abandonados.
Diseña el mapa para persecuciones entre jugadores: agrega rutas alternativas, atajos, escondites naturales, zonas abiertas y zonas cerradas. Evita caminos lineales.
Usa iluminación nocturna con luz de luna, sombras profundas, niebla, árboles bloqueando la visión y zonas de oscuridad total. El mapa debe estar optimizado para Roblox y preparado para añadir mecánicas después.

image_prompt.text: Natural hiding places built into the undergrowth - hollow trunks, thickets and rock clefts - where a player breaks line of sight, at least 4 studs on the entry axis
A large structural exit set into the outer boundary of the map
An enormous dense night forest of giant trees and thick vegetation, divided into zones with distinctly different ambience
Narrow winding trails through the trees, deliberately non-linear, with alternative routes and shortcuts between them
Rocks, fallen logs, rolling hills, small rivers and lakes scattered through the forest
An abandoned cabin in a clearing
A wooden watchtower standing above the canopy
A wooden bridge crossing a river
A cave entrance in a hillside
Abandoned vehicles left along the trails
Alternating open clearings and tightly enclosed thickets so chases change character as they move

layout_placement.text: Separated start points so a pursuing player and a fleeing player do not begin on top of each other

notes: Shape chosen for the chase requirement - alternative routes, shortcuts and no linear paths is exactly the zero-dead-ends property, which is why this routes P6.

The prompt also asks for the forest to be divided into distinct zones. That reads like the Biome World shape, but only one shape can be picked and chase topology is the stronger requirement, so zones are carried as free text.
The user explicitly asked for scenery only - no NPCs, scripts, UI, weapons or systems. The preset's escape gate and role spawns are kept per intake policy but both fight that instruction.
Whether the cabin, watchtower and cave are enterable is unresolved; if they are, this gains P3.
No option in Survival covers a navigational landmark, so the watchtower is free text.

open_questions.ask: Are the cabin, watchtower and cave actually enterable, or are they exterior set dressing only?
Should the zones differ in threat as well as ambience, or is it purely a visual change?

theme: Horror - realistic dark night forest, moonlit, heavy shadow and light fog

coverage_missing.ask: Are the points of interest enterable, or exterior only?
Is 2000x2000 a hard boundary or an approximate target?

answers.ask: Are the cabin, watchtower and cave actually enterable, or are they exterior set dressing only?
answers.answer: La cabaña, la torre de vigilancia y la cueva deben ser accesibles y explorables, con interiores pequeños y simples optimizados para Roblox.

answers.ask: Should the zones differ in threat as well as ambience, or is it purely a visual change?
answers.answer: Las zonas deben diferenciarse solo por ambiente visual y distribución del terreno; no agregues niveles de amenaza ni mecánicas de juego.
